text:
Anna L: quick thread — proposal to add `pin_intent` + `rollback_hint` fields to rollout metadata. trying to capture operator intent (sticky vs ephemeral), and an explicit rollback suggestion to help automated fallback policies.

Kevin M: high level yes from me. can you sketch minimal schema and migration notes?

Anna L: minimal idea: `pin_intent` = \"sticky|soft|ephemeral\"; `soft_ttl` (seconds) optional; `hard_ttl` required for enforced expiry; `rollback_hint` = \"previous_variant_id\" or \"fallback_policy:region\". clients that don't understand new fields should ignore them (no breaking).

Sasha P: +1. question: how do we resolve conflicting pins from different controllers? e.g., automated canary vs manual sticky pin.

Anna L: conflict resolution options: 1) owner-priority (manual wins), 2) epoch-wins (latest write by epoch), 3) priority-weighted (controller-level weights). leaning toward owner-priority for safety, with an audit trail and a `conflict_count` metric.

Bhaskar R: owner-priority seems safe but ops wants a way to forcibly override for emergencies. propose an `override_by` enum plus `override_expiry`. overrides should be gated by RBAC.

Kevin M: storage concerns — if we add soft_ttl/hard_ttl and rollback_hint, we need indexes for eviction queries. suggest composite index: `(tenant_id, model_id, effective_expiry)` and a small LRU for hot pins in serving layer.

infra-bot: deploy-check: pin metadata size impact estimate: +~40 bytes per pin on average, migration I/O ~ proportional to active pins (~600k) — eta: 10m write ops, can background roll.

Sasha P: telemetry: add counters `pin.set`, `pin.update`, `pin.evict.soft`, `pin.evict.hard`, `pin.conflict` and histograms for `pin.latency_ms`. we need alerts for spikes in `pin.conflict` and sustained `pin.evict.hard` increases.

Anna L: migration plan sketch: 1) add nullable fields to schema (no downtime). 2) backfill `soft_ttl` from existing lease window where available. 3) phased client rollout: server accepts new fields but old clients ignore. 4) enable owner-priority conflict resolution behind feature flag then flip after 2 weeks of metrics stability.

Kevin M: operational nit: when `soft_ttl` expires, runtime should keep serving until `hard_ttl` but mark as \"stale\" in logs/traces so developers can see regressions. also for canaries set `rollback_hint` automatically at canary creation time.

Bhaskar R: security note: rollback_hint may contain variant ids; ensure it doesn't leak tenant-scoped secrets. store as opaque ids only.

Sasha P: small API example for clarity:
```
PATCH /v1/pins/{pin_id}
{
  "pin_intent": "soft",
  "soft_ttl": 3600,
  "hard_ttl": 86400,
  "rollback_hint": "variant:v3-2026-03-20"
}
```

Anna L: open question: do we need a `pin_reason` free-text field for ops notes? pros: debuggability. cons: unstructured blob. lean: include optional short `pin_note` (max 256 chars).

Kevin M: +1 for `pin_note` with length cap. also add audit log entry on every change with actor, timestamp, reason.

infra-bot: safety-check: adding `pin_note` increases index footprint if we index by note (we won't). ok to add as non-indexed field.

Sasha P: decision checklist before rolling: schema PR, runtime handling of soft vs hard, conflict-policy flag + RBAC, indexes + background backfill, telemetry+alerts, migration runbook. assign owners?

Anna L: I'll own schema PR and migration runbook. Sasha you take telemetry/alerts. Kevin take runtime + index changes. Bhaskar handle RBAC/override gating. I'll open issues and link here.

deploy-ci: created ticket INF-4721 with checklist items and labels (schema, migration, telemetry, ops-runbook).

Kevin M: thanks all. small followup — add a short sample of eviction log line so SRE knows what to parse.

Anna L: example log: `evict(pin_id=abc123 tenant=redwood-42 model=llama-13b reason=soft_ttl_expired soft_ttl=3600 hard_ttl=86400 owner=team-x conflict=false)`

Sasha P: nice. I'm going to add parsing rules in logging infra. will post PR link later.

Bhaskar R: SGTM.

Anna L: end — thanks everyone. I'll post the schema PR link once ready. :rocket:
